sources.title: Viṣṇupurāṇa
sources.author: Traditional attribution: Vyāsa
sources.quality: Primary Purāṇa e-text based on the 1910 Veṅkaṭeśvara edition; GRETIL header states that after 1,500 corrections the text still needs proof-reading.
sources.notes: Citation locators use the vip_3,6.27 and vip_3,6.28 reference system.

sources.title: Kāmasūtra
sources.author: Vātsyāyana
sources.edition: GRETIL e-text input by Jean Fezas; print edition not stated on the source page
sources.license: GRETIL reference-use terms; rights as source file
sources.quality: Digital text with notes; edition metadata absent and the 64-item list has an omitted parenthetical item number at item 12.
sources.notes: The list is called aṅga-vidyā in 1.3.15, not kalā; the 64-kalā nomenclature is supplied by Kāvyamīmāṃsā 2.

sources.title: Kāmasūtra
sources.author: Vātsyāyana
sources.edition: Kāmasūtram with the commentary of Yaśodhara, dvitīya saṃskaraṇa, Nirṇayasāgarayantrālaya, 1900, with reference to the Chaukhambha Sanskrit Sansthan edition (saṃvat 2049); e-text data entry by Mizue Sugita (1998/2020)
sources.quality: Independent transcription of the 1900 Nirṇayasāgara edition; page numbers and Chaukhambha variants are marked inline with parentheses and [ch:...] brackets.
sources.notes: Second witness for the aṅga-vidyā list at Kāmasūtra 1.3.15; resolves the GRETIL empty-parenthetical artifact at item 12. Markup is stripped for evidence matching only; the cached file is unmodified.

sources.title: Muṇḍakopaniṣad
sources.author: Vedic tradition
sources.edition: Sanskrit Documents e-text; proofread by Avinash Sathaye, P.P. Narayanaswami, and John Manetta
sources.license: Sanskrit Documents terms; educational use; redistribution restricted
sources.quality: Proofread volunteer e-text; ITRANS encoding converted to IAST for evidence matching.
sources.notes: The source header does not state a critical edition.

sources.title: Kāvyamīmāṃsā, Adhikaraṇa 1
sources.author: Rājaśekhara
sources.edition: Sansknet input; GRETIL e-text; print edition not stated
sources.license: GRETIL reference-use terms; rights as source file
sources.quality: GRETIL explicitly marks the text as not proof-read; one typo is visible in the 14-vidyāsthāna passage.
sources.notes: Used only for explicit statements whose exact strings are present; uncertain readings stay flagged.

sources.title: Aṣṭādhyāyī sūtrapāṭha
sources.author: Pāṇini
sources.quality: Machine-readable sūtrapāṭha with one rule per row; exact SLP1 strings are used as evidence.
sources.notes: All 3,983 sūtra rows are selected; exact row offsets are used as evidence. The 20-rule pilot was audited against /root/iks-core; full coverage remains Vidyut-sourced, with fixture differences documented in README.

sources.title: Dhātupāṭha
sources.author: Pāṇini
sources.quality: Machine-readable dhātupāṭha used as the independent cross-check for the ashtadhyayi.com data.
sources.notes: Root upadeśa strings include anubandha and accent marks; meanings are compared after transliteration. All 2,259 codes correspond to the primary dataset; 01.1114 has a documented meaning variant.

sources.title: Dhātupāṭha data
sources.author: Pāṇini
sources.license: Free use with attribution, per repository README
sources.quality: Structured dhātu records with baseindex, gana, pada, Sanskrit artha, English gloss, and tags.
sources.notes: The primary dhātu record source; Vidyut is used as an independent code-and-meaning cross-check. The dataset has 2,259 rows: 2,229 roots plus 30 gaṇasūtras; 09.0029 lacks an English gloss.

sources.title: The Sarva-Darśana-Saṃgraha, table of contents
sources.author: Mādhava; E. B. Cowell and A. E. Gough (tr.)
sources.edition: London: Trübner, 1882; online table of contents
sources.license: Public-domain 1882 translation; page access via Wisdom Library
sources.quality: English table of contents of the 16-chapter printed edition; it is not a Sanskrit critical edition.
sources.notes: Most manuscripts contain 15 chapters; chapter XVI is a later addition in some editions. The project uses the chapter titles only as doxographic coverage evidence.

sources.title: Monier-Williams Sanskrit-English Dictionary, guṇa entry
sources.author: Monier Monier-Williams
sources.license: Cologne Digital Sanskrit Dictionaries; academic reference use
sources.quality: Lexicographic cross-check only; not used as a grammatical definition source.
sources.notes: The live MW entry was used to reject the unsourced sample dhātu claim गूँठि/गण् for guṇa.
